answer.reason: Iconium is where Paul and Barnabas preached in the synagogue and many believed, which is a defining event of the place.

clauses.english: was where Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue and a great multitude of Jews and Greeks believed
clauses.quote: a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed

doubts: ACT 14:19 names Jews from Iconium who stoned Paul at Lystra; that event happened at Lystra, so it is not made a clause.
ACT 14:3 context (long stay, signs and wonders) is only partly shown and is not cited.
